command_line: [ -f /usr/local/ssl/cacert.pem ] && export SSL_CERT_FILE="/usr/local/ssl/cacert.pem";  datasets download gene gene-id '6469'     --include gene,rna,cds,5p-utr --no-progressbar  && dataformat tsv gene --package ncbi_dataset.zip --fields gene-id,symbol,tax-id,tax-name,common-name,description,transcript-count,protein-count,ensembl-geneids,annotation-release-name,annotation-genomic-range-seq-name,annotation-genomic-range-accession,genomic-region-gene-range-accession,genomic-region-gene-range-range-start,genomic-region-gene-range-range-stop,genomic-region-gene-range-range-orientation,genomic-region-gene-range-range-order --force > gene_data_report.tsv   && unzip ncbi_dataset.zip
